name: av_inflation
description:
Annual US inflation rate (consumer prices, percent) from Alpha Vantage (INFLATION). Takes no inputs.
Returns: {name, interval, unit, data: [{date, value}]} with yearly values as strings, newest first. Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
For the monthly index level use av_cpi; other sources: fred_cpi, openbb_economy_cpi.
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {}
